scope: UX-0 read-only fictional prototype; presentation semantics only, not the NAPMS domain schema

policy.purpose: Declared permit rules only; AccessRequest is provenance, never a policy rule

distinctions: ALLOWED/DENIED describe a request decision, not technical permit/deny
PolicyRule.Active describes rule lifecycle, not AccessRequest.ALLOWED
Read-only describes prototype UI mode, never Application lifecycle
Immutable describes revision parameter integrity, never revision lifecycle
Unknown/Uncomparable must not be interpreted as success
